summary: The DestinationClosures module manages closures associated with destinations by providing CRUD operations, validations, and retrievals. It handles business rules for closure codes, dates, and ensures proper system behavior and data integrity.
purpose: To allow authorized actors to create, update, delete, and query destination closures, enforcing business rules regarding closure types and date ranges, and supporting multi-language fields.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the closure entry.

fields.name: DestinationCodeID
fields.description: References the destination associated with the closure.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.description: The start date for the closure period.

fields.name: EndDate
fields.description: The end date for the closure period.

fields.name: ClosureCode
fields.description: The code or label for the closure, including multi-language support.

actors.name: HSPnetSession
actors.description: Represents a user session, providing access to database and system messages.

workflows.name: Add DestinationClosure
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, DestinationCodeID, ClosureCodeID, StartDate, EndDate.

workflows.name: Update DestinationClosure
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, DestinationClosureID, ClosureCodeID, StartDate, EndDate.

workflows.name: Search DestinationClosures
steps: Fetch results, build DestinationClosure list using FillList.
Handle alternate language fields if session uses them.

workflows.name: Search DestinationClosure by ID
steps: Fetch results, build DestinationClosure list using FillList.

business_rules: StartDate must not be more than 5 years in the future.
EndDate must not be more than 5 years in the future.
StartDate must not be after EndDate.
validations: IsValid(Sess) must be true for add/update operations.
Session messages are used to provide user feedback on errors.
calculations: StartDateFormatted and EndDateFormatted are short formatted representations used for display and input.
MaxDate is calculated as current date plus maximum allowed future years.
conditions: ClosureCode field switches to alternate language if session specifies UseAltLanguageFields.
system_behavior: Procedures are called for each operation (add, update, delete, search).
Errors and validation messages are raised via session's Messages collection.
dependencies: HSPnetSession required for database access and validation.
DateFormatter and Resources for formatting dates and error messages.
exceptions: Validation failures on mandatory fields or date ranges result in error messages and operation abort.
Delete operates only if numeric id is > 0.
